ValidationRule.description: Requires key lead workflow fields before marking a Facebook inquiry qualified or converted.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Inquiry_Status__c), ISCHANGED(Qualified_Lead__c)), OR(ISPICKVAL(Inquiry_Status__c, "Qualified Lead"), ISPICKVAL(Inquiry_Status__c, "Converted"), Qualified_Lead__c), OR( ISBLANK(Contact__c), ISBLANK(Assigned_Agent__c), ISPICKVAL(Lead_Stage__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Next_Action__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Payment_Intent__c, "") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before qualification, complete Contact, Assigned Agent, Lead Stage, Next Action, and Payment Intent.
